tort.name: Paraquat
tort.headline: Worked with Paraquat and later diagnosed with Parkinson's?
tort.lede: People who mixed, loaded or sprayed Paraquat (Gramoxone) at work and were later diagnosed with Parkinson's disease may be able to file a claim. Check in two minutes, or talk it through with Sofia.

qualifies: Parkinson's disease diagnosed by a doctor
Occupational exposure: mixed, loaded, applied/sprayed, or flagged
Product mixed with water, from a farm or ag supplier
Exposure at 18+ (or at least one full season if younger)
Not represented, never signed with a lawyer on this
criteria.approved_by: Receiving firm criteria as encoded in Sofia BTL Paraquat v4 (2026-09-28)

quiz.q: Has a doctor diagnosed you (or the person you're asking for) with Parkinson's disease?
Is a lawyer already handling this, or has anyone signed with a lawyer about it?

options.label: Yes, a lawyer is handling it

quiz.q: Was the Paraquat exposure part of a job?
quiz.hint: Farm work, spraying and crop dusting are common examples.

options.label: No, home, garden or hobby use

quiz.q: What did they do with it?
Was it mixed with water before spraying, and where did it come from?
quiz.hint: Paraquat is also sold as Gramoxone.

options.label: Mixed with water, from a farm or ag supplier

quiz.q: About when did the exposure start?
How old were they when it started?
Roughly how big was the farm or area?
The firm asks everyone this: has the person ever used methamphetamine?
